name: Sub-Decree No. 167 (2026 public holidays) — Andersen Cambodia summary
description: Law-firm summary of Sub-Decree No. 167 of the Royal Government of Cambodia (issued 18 September 2025) establishing the 2026 public holidays.
verification_notes: Secondary source; the sub-decree text itself has not yet been reviewed. The article states 22 paid days but its table sums to 21. Another summary (Prasac) gives a different issue date for the sub-decree. Upgrade records to 'official' only after checking the primary text.

name: Cambodia public holidays 2025 — MRTS Consulting summary
description: Published 2025 holiday list: Visak Bochea 11 May, Royal Ploughing 15 May, Pchum Ben 21–23 September, Water Festival 4–6 November.
verification_notes: Dates agree with Calendarific's 2025 Cambodia list. Primary Prakas not reviewed.

name: Cambodia public holidays 2024 — Swiss Embassy and ARDB lists
description: Published 2024 holiday list: Visak Bochea 22 May, Royal Ploughing 26 May, Pchum Ben 1–3 October, Water Festival 14–16 November.
verification_notes: Water Festival dates cross-checked with ARDB and Calendarific. At least one listing (Siem Reap) disagrees for Visak and Ploughing; majority of sources used.
